verdict.rationale: Codex documents a dedicated review command that runs against uncommitted changes, a commit, or a base branch and reports prioritized findings without modifying the working tree. It can also start cloud work from GitHub pull requests, and `codex exec` can be called from CI pipelines. However, nothing in the evidence shows reviews triggering automatically on every PR or feedback being posted as PR comments; that behavior would have to be wired up yourself via CI. Missing for 10: automatic per-PR review triggering, inline or contextual PR comment feedback, first-party docs for a PR review integration, independent or hands-on corroboration of review quality.
